## Claim or representation

Identify the pack, question, mechanism, source, or model. Include the app/release version and distinguish curated content from provisional retrieval.

## Source and context

Provide PMID, DOI, or an accessible source URL, plus the relevant organism, tissue, population, and experimental setting. Use a short relevant passage or paraphrase; do not upload a full copyrighted article.

## Why it may be wrong

Explain the mismatch, missing contradiction, unsupported causal language, or incorrect model assumption. Distinguish source content from your proposed interpretation.

## Suggested correction

State a narrower claim or evidence/model change and any remaining uncertainty. Do not include personal medical questions or operational dosing, synthesis, or procurement instructions.
